caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair set against a plain, light beige background. The chair is colored in various shades of brown, with darker tones used for shadows and details. It features turned legs and arm supports, curved armrests, and a wide, slightly concave seat. The two rockers at the bottom are also dark brown and smoothly curved. The backrest is rectangular, with a central splat and two side spindles, and it is slightly reclined. There is a decorative floral pattern in muted yellow, orange, and red hues on the top rail of the backrest. The signature "Violet Hartenstein" appears in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Rocker
